rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi/participial compound kṛta-kautuka-bandhaḥ with nominative singular masculine ending; final visarga becomes s before tu
compound sthaṇḍila-stham, object of worship located on the ritual platform

items.question: What worship must be performed after binding the protective thread?
premises: The protective thread binding has already been completed.
The object of worship is placed on the ritual altar.
A prescribed act of worship is enjoined in this state.
items.inference: Therefore, after tying the protective thread, one should worship what is placed on the altar.
uncertainties: The exact referent of sthaṇḍilasthaṃ is implicit and taken as the deity or ritual presence on the altar.
items.plain_english: Having tied the protective thread, one should then worship the deity placed on the altar.
